symptom: describe layout → create layout copies of Atlas layouts: Phone_/Tablet_ copies print `-- Forms$Header (header1)  -- NOT re-executable` and lose HeaderLeft/HeaderRight (pages bound to them: CE1613); Phone_Sidebar/Tablet_Sidebar copies fail mx check CE0611 "A sidebar toggle button is required if a region can toggle"; NativePhone_* copies silently lose the Header placeholder, ShowBottomBar and the sidebar (pages: CE1613 "The selected placeholder '…Header' no longer exists")
cause: No MDL for Forms$Header (LeftWidgets/RightWidgets), so the header and the toggle inside it were dropped while the region's ToggleMode (round-tripped since #1220) survived — the CE0611 was that fix exposing the drop. Native layouts: layoutContentToGen wrote 4 of the 8 keys of Forms$NativeLayoutContent and describe never read RightHeaderPlaceholder / ShowBottomBar / Sidebar / SidebarWidgets, with no NOT re-executable note
insight: Test a copy path against EVERY document of the kind, not the reported one: `TestCopyEveryAtlasLayoutKeepsEveryWidget` copies all 22 Atlas_Core layouts and compares each copy's widget $Types+key sets and its Content wrapper to the original — that found the native drop, which no NOT re-executable comment ever announced. Do the mx check on a NEW app (`mxcli new … --version 11.13.0`), not testdata/pedapp: PedApp ships no theme and reports ~1000 CE6083 and 26 CE0535 on its own untouched layouts, and a CE0535 on a copy was first misread as a copy defect — it is the fixture's (a new app copying all 22 is 0 errors). Fixing one property (ToggleMode) can turn a silent drop next to it into a build error; rerun the whole set after each. Control: main's binary, copying NativePhone_SideMenu plus a page bound to its placeholders → 2× CE1613; this branch → 0 errors
